representation.qonductor: Archive-supported MQT recipe, not recovered original logical DAG. Physical-feature methods retain exact submitted physical QASM.
representation.qpack: Source-backed angle-insensitive structural QAOA reconstruction. Parameter values and submitted routing are not recovered; compiled-feature methods use the previously frozen representative-angle nominal compiled view, with this approximation disclosed.
representation.mali: Original source logical QASM; nominal target compilation only for compiled-feature/analytical methods.
representation.eligibility: Graph/51-global inputs omit numeric angle values. This permits the declared structural adaptation, not claims about fidelity of the reconstructed state's amplitudes or exact historical compilation. Do not use zero-input output agreement as proof of historical DAG identity.

split.groups: conservative transitive circuit/workflow/model-visible structural components; parameter-invariant structures joined when declared inputs omit angles; backend and shots do not separate a shared structure
split.validation: Neural fit uses inner1-3; inner0 selects the epoch. Regressors tune over all four inner folds then refit outer-train. All methods share outer-test IDs.
split.minimum_support: All three sources represented in every outer test and inner validation; no outer/inner group overlap. Backend support is reported, not silently enforced by resampling rare contexts.

neural.representation: Pinned 51 raw globals plus original upstream 178-field DAG and nominal-index T1/T2; global-only MLP is matched. Preserve all raw globals; fit-only upstream masks/normalization.
neural.selection: Minimum inner0 validation MSE after all 500 epochs; earliest tie; fresh initialization and train-only transformations; no checkpoint reuse from another training population.
neural.seed_reduction: Per-row median only when all three seed predictions exist; retain individual seeds.
neural.checkpoint: Atomic every epoch with optimizer, RNG, current/best states and context/transform/runner/model/environment identity. Resume only exact matching identities.

regression.swap: Pinned upstream CX/CZ/ECR counter, not literal SWAP.
regression.selection: Mean raw-seconds R2 over four inner folds, earliest candidate tie. Optional family selector uses only inner scores. No source/backend one-hot or source missing mask.
regression.source: Same pinned source/grid transcription as completed strict_method_completion; disclose the bounded search as an adaptation.

analytical.qiskit: Reuse hash-pinned raw nominal duration, not fitted predictions; measurement semantics unchanged.
analytical.qcre: Invoke pinned qcre estimate_runtime through BQSKit on the frozen compiled/submitted unitary view. Omit terminal measurement explicitly; barriers omitted, nonunitary/classical operations unsupported. Do not substitute the custom critical-path proxy.
analytical.hyb: Reuse the audited nominal r2 component log cost and raw values. Preserve true-zero survival and float64 overflow. Fit nominal log-cost Ridge anew with alpha0.1/1/10/100 selected by source-balanced inner MAE. No automatic alternate-snapshot selection.
analytical.scholten: Pinned unified nominal throughput and compiled wire-depth proxy, not original QV-normalized effective depth. Original-paper eligibility remains explicit unavailable where kernel n/template D are absent. No CLOPS_h/v conversion.
analytical.calibration: Raw, shot-scaled, affine and log-affine are separate outputs. Fresh affine/log-affine fitting on successful outer-train only; projection max(pred,0) only for declared analytical calibration and log-error reporting.

gates: 4515 exact selected IDs and tier/source counts
CUDA synthetic gradient/Adam parity and largest intact fit graph
fold0 all six neural cells completed with correct IDs/epoch/transform/checkpoint hashes before later folds

resources.training_timeout: No fixed circuit timeout; checkpoint every epoch and stop on correctness/nonfinite errors, not poor scores.

reporting.paired: Compare identical held-out successful IDs; publish n/ID hash and10000 grouped bootstrap replicates seed42. Distinguish observed MAE delta from bootstrap mean. No universal ranking across unequal subsets.
